A [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed '''[[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]''' was wielded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]].

==History==
===Training Padawans===
{{Quote|The lightsaber, singular tool of the Jedi, a symbol of our order and often enough, the difference between life and death.|Mavra Zane|<ref name="KSW" />}}
During the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], while en route to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Master Mavra Zane and a group of [[Padawan/Legends|padawans]] started practicing [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] aboard their ship with Zane using her lightsaber to demonstrate.<ref name="KSW" />

===Kashyyyk===
[[File:Mavrazane.jpg|thumb|100px|left|Mavra wielding her lightsaber]]
Upon arrival at Kashyyyk, Zane and her padawans found themselves in a [[Attack on Kashyyyk|conflict]] with an alliance of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]s and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]s. Zane wielded her lightsaber into battle against them.<ref name="KSW" />
